findings.function: zap, quote functions, owner, set_mint_buffer, sweep and the token-list getters

findings.source: Zap.sol immutables (YB, YYB, POOL, the token addresses) and owner() read from an immutable vault
findings.issue: All token immutables read as 0, so the token checks fold (only address 0 is a valid input, and then output 0 is 'same token') and zap always reverts; owner() calls address 0.

findings.source: returning a fixed list of 4 / 6 token immutables as address[]
findings.issue: The constant-length encoding loop copies words the text has just set to 0, so the result is a known array of zeros; the zero stores are written twice (P8).
findings.rule: Evaluate a constant-trip-count loop over known memory (or turn it into a copy line); merge a zero fill with the following zero stores of the same words.

notes: No explicit loops in the source. The two whiles are the address[] encodings of constant-length lists (P7). set_mint_buffer (0x72aac6a1) and sweep are faithful (owner check, buffer bound 500, transfer to owner). No semantic error found.
summary: Short and faithful: the immutables read as 0 collapse the zap paths to reverts; only two constant-length encoding loops over known zero memory remain to simplify.
